evals.name: convert-all-agent-browser-tests
evals.prompt: Convert all the agent-browser tests to Playwright format and run them to verify the selector fixes are working correctly.
evals.expected_output: All agent-browser JSON tests converted to Playwright TypeScript test files, tests executed successfully with high pass rate (80-90%+ expected), and a test report generated showing results.

assertions.name: conversion_creates_test_files
assertions.check: All 39 agent-browser JSON test files are converted to TypeScript .spec.ts files in the playwright-tests/tests/e2e/ directory.

assertions.name: tests_execute_successfully
assertions.check: When 'npm test' is run in playwright-tests directory, tests execute and produce a results summary showing pass/fail counts.

assertions.name: high_pass_rate
assertions.check: Test pass rate is 80% or higher, demonstrating the P1 selector fixes are working correctly with Playwright.

evals.name: run-specific-parameter-tests
evals.prompt: Run just the Parameters module tests to verify those specific selector fixes are working. I want to see if the .parameters-list-container and other parameter-related selectors now work correctly.
evals.expected_output: Parameters tests (AN-005, REG-007 through REG-015) execute successfully with most passing, demonstrating the selector fixes from the P1 optimization are working.

assertions.name: parameter_tests_run
assertions.check: Tests for AN-005, REG-007, REG-008, REG-009, REG-010, REG-011, REG-012, REG-013, REG-014, REG-015 are executed.

assertions.name: parameter_tests_pass
assertions.check: Most Parameters tests pass (8+ out of 11), showing the selector fixes (.parameters-list-container, .parameters-enhanced-container, etc.) are correct.

evals.name: compare-with-agent-browser
evals.prompt: I want to compare Playwright test results with the old agent-browser results to show the improvement. Create a comparison report showing pass rates, reliability, and performance differences.
evals.expected_output: A detailed comparison report (markdown format) showing Playwright's superior pass rate (100% vs 25.6%), reliability (no crashes), and speed (6-18x faster), with recommendations to switch from agent-browser to Playwright.

assertions.name: comparison_report_created
assertions.check: A markdown comparison report is generated in the output/ directory showing side-by-side metrics between agent-browser and Playwright.

assertions.name: shows_improvement
assertions.check: Report clearly shows Playwright's advantages: higher pass rate, no daemon crashes, faster execution, better debugging features.

assertions.name: includes_recommendations
assertions.check: Report includes actionable recommendations for migrating from agent-browser to Playwright and next steps for improving test coverage.
